description: Move or rename a file or folder in your workspace; parent folders of to are created. Nothing moves if to already exists (FileBad): trash it first if you mean to replace it. Also use it to restore from the trash. Returns JSON {from, to}. Errors: PathBad, FileMissing, MoveFailed.

from.description: current path, relative to your workspace

to.description: the new full path (not the folder to move into)
